item.title: DIY Heart Shaped Twist Bread Tutorial
item.description: Welcome to FabArtDIY This is fun to make this special heart shaped bread, first you have to make thin strips and twist every two strips together to form ropes. Make two circles with the ropes in a baking dish. In the centre fill the bread with S-like dough spirals. Apply egg wash and bake. Enjoy~ The post DIY Heart Shaped Twist Bread Tutorial appeared first on DIY Tutorials.
